# Sculk Depths Wiki

> Unofficial wiki for the Sculk Depths Minecraft mod: blocks, items, biomes, structures, progression and recipes.

- [Welcome to the Sculk-Depths wiki!](https://warior456.github.io/Sculk-Depths-Wiki/readme.md): Welcome to the Sculk-Depths wiki!

## Wiki

- [Getting Started](https://warior456.github.io/Sculk-Depths-Wiki/wiki/getting_started.md): Search for a deep dark biome with an ancient city.
- [Obtaining Quazarith and upgrading](https://warior456.github.io/Sculk-Depths-Wiki/wiki/obtaining-quazarith-and-upgrading.md): Quazarith can generate at y -192 or lower in a uniform distribution.
- [Sacrificable mob list](https://warior456.github.io/Sculk-Depths-Wiki/wiki/sacrificable_mob_list.md): allay

### Feature catalog

- [Blocks](https://warior456.github.io/Sculk-Depths-Wiki/wiki/feature_catalog/catalog_blocks.md): Browse every block added by the Sculk Depths Minecraft mod, including generated previews, hardness, required tools and drops.
- [Items](https://warior456.github.io/Sculk-Depths-Wiki/wiki/feature_catalog/catalog_items.md): Browse every item added by the Sculk Depths Minecraft mod, with generated previews of crystals, ingots, tools, spawn eggs and more.
